lines.line: In Aero, you can copy yourself as many times as you like.
Drag a box around yourself, copy, and paste, and now there are four of you.
Throw every head at the same spot.
The bodies grow back, fall into the same step, and merge into one.
Hold Shift while you aim, and the crew keeps its formation.
